critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/auth/app-return doesn't declare `to` as a FastAPI query parameter (it's read client-side from the browser URL via the inline JS). This is intentional per the comment at line 556-560 of 03_auth.py (no server-side data flow — the fragment is parsed client-side). FastAPI silently ignores the unused `to` query string, which is the desired behavior for the bridge page use case.
